---
description: Draft a Delegation Decision Record before a delegated build
agent: ask
---
Read context/FEATURES.md, context/CLAUDE.md, and docs/DDR-LOG.md.
Ask me which EARS rows I am about to delegate and to which tool.
Then draft docs/DDR-NNN.md (next number in the log) with these sections:
Task; Decision (what is delegated and what stays human, with the reason);
Tool; Why delegate (hours by hand vs delegated, net, and the risk that could flip it);
Crossing (what data or secrets leave the browser, and to where); Budget (prompts or credits);
Verification planned (named test files and a second grader); Accountable.
Leave the Outcome section empty. Do not write the file; show me the draft.
